validation.result: Both validation commands pass with exact expected behavior. (1) Dry-run after deleting tests/golden/tmp/run: exit 0, displays executable path <root>/tools/mame.exe, working directory = the tools folder containing mame.exe, and the full argument list identical to KB-28a §3 in order — galaxian, -rompath roms, -noreadconfig, -cfg_directory/-nvram_directory/-snapshot_directory/-input_directory/-state_directory pointing at tests/golden/tmp/run/{cfg,nvram,snap,inp,sta}, -skip_gameinfo, -nothrottle, -frameskip 0, -noautoframeskip, -norewind, -noautosave, -autoboot_delay 0 — without launching MAME or touching the filesystem (run dir confirmed absent afterwards). (2) Real run with extra args after --: exit code 0, output contains 'romset galaxian is good', and tests/golden/tmp/run was deleted then recreated with all 5 subdirs before launch. MAME_DIR override honored at runtime (bogus dir → clean error exit 1; real dir → same executable). Exit-code propagation implemented via status.code().unwrap_or(1); launcher errors return 1. Unit tests are pure argument-construction/path-logic tests (common_profile, build_args, mame_path) — no MAME launch, no filesystem writes. Clippy -D warnings clean across the workspace; all 13 xtask tests green.

notes: Budget B.6 holds: single mechanism (MAME golden launcher), 2 source files touched besides .gitignore (golden.rs new ~135 lines of implementation + main.rs wiring diff of a few lines; total well under 150 new impl lines), no external dependencies added to xtask (crates/xtask/Cargo.toml unchanged, std-only).
.gitignore adds tools/ and tests/golden/tmp/ as unversioned — consistent with the MAME toolchain being a local artifact.
The pre-existing orphan crates/xtask/src/golden_trace/mod.rs is not wired into main.rs; intentionally left untouched per task context (out of scope, not flagged).
Minor observation (non-blocking): --dry-run placed after -- is filtered out of the MAME argument list by design (documented in code comment); harmless and sensible.
